summary: OSR Holdings filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting that its Board decided to postpone the 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders, previously scheduled for June 18, 2026, to allow more time to evaluate certain meeting matters. No new date was set; the company will announce rescheduling in a later filing. This is a procedural postponement of an annual meeting, not a special situation event. No deal terms, premiums, advisors, or activist involvement are mentioned. The filing is purely administrative and does not trigger a special-situation classification.
